topic: What are the fundamental principles of collective motion?
research_question: Which measurable, conditional mechanisms predict transitions among collective-motion states across biological and engineered groups?

selected_idea.title: MOSAIC: Mechanism-Observable State Atlas and Invariance Calibration

central_conclusion: Collective motion should be treated as a conditional predictive invariant among activity, coupling, fluctuations, delay, and geometry, not as a single universal microscopic interaction law inferred from visually similar trajectories.
human_review_items: Verify frozen DOI metadata against publisher pages once the in-app browser ACL issue is resolved.
Confirm licensing, ethics, and measurement quality for every future public trajectory or velocity-field dataset.
Pre-register data-specific normalizations, non-inferiority margins, and candidate interaction kernels before opening held-out domains.
Obtain qualified safety and regulatory approval before any animal, biological, or drone acquisition.
